labels.note: False and None are both falsy in the truthy checks used by retry logic; no observable difference.
retry_always must always be truthy; None is falsy, so it would stop retrying entirely.
Final fallback False only reached when outcome succeeded; None is equally falsy, no behavior change.
Fallback False (no matching cause) becomes None, still falsy; truthiness-based logic unaffected.
Reached only when outcome failed; False vs None both falsy, no observable difference in retry decision.
Same as retry_if_result fallback: falsy False replaced by falsy None, no behavior change.
__ror__ should return a combined retry_any object; returning None breaks chained '|' retry composition.
__rand__ should return a combined retry_all object; returning None breaks chained '&' retry composition.
